blocks.text: Photosynthesis mein roshni (light) ki tawanai istemal hoti hai: photosynthetic pigments (rang dene wale madde) roshni jazb (absorb) kar ke use chemical tawanai mein badalte hain. Podon mein photosynthesis ko mukhtasar taur par yun likhte hain:

Carbon dioxide, pani aur roshni reactants (shuru ki cheezein) hain, jabke glucose aur oxygen products (banne wali cheezein) hain. Pani equation ke dono taraf is liye hai ke kuch reactions mein pani istemal hota hai aur kuch mein banta hai. Lekin aakhir mein pani ki koi khalis (net) paidawar nahin hoti.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Photosynthesis woh amal hai jis mein carbon ka kam tawanai wala inorganic compound (CO₂) reduce ho kar zyada tawanai wale carbohydrates banata hai.

blocks.title: Compensation point
blocks.text: Photosynthesis respiration ke products (CO₂ aur pani) istemal karti hai aur respiration photosynthesis ke products (glucose aur O₂). Photosynthesis sirf din mein hoti hai, magar respiration din raat chalti hai. Andhere mein patte aur doosre hisse respiration karte hain, oxygen lete aur carbon dioxide chhorte hain. Subah aur shaam, jab roshni kam hoti hai, photosynthesis aur respiration ki raftar thori der ke liye barabar ho sakti hai: photosynthesis se nikli oxygen bilkul utni hoti hai jitni respiration ko chahiye, aur respiration se nikli CO₂ bilkul utni jitni photosynthesis ko chahiye. Us waqt patton aur hawa ke darmiyan gases ka koi khalis tabadla (net exchange) nahin hota; isi ko compensation point kehte hain. Dopahar ko roshni tez hone se photosynthesis bhi tez ho jati hai aur zyada CO₂ chahiye hoti hai jo akeli respiration nahin de sakti; aur photosynthesis ki oxygen respiration ki zaroorat se zyada hoti hai. Natija: patte oxygen bahar chhorte aur CO₂ andar lete hain.
Roshni ka kirdar

Photosynthesis mein roshni bohat aham hai: yeh woh tawanai deti hai jis se chemical reactions chalte hain aur saada molecules pecheeda (complex) organic compounds ban jate hain. Roshni ki tawanai chlorophyll jazb karta hai. Yeh jazb hui tawanai chemical tawanai mein badalti hai aur organic compounds mein C-H bonds ki tawanai ki shakal mein jama ho jati hai. (Kitab yahan “It happens like this;” likhti hai magar aage koi khaaka nahin chhapti.)

blocks.title: Sirf 1-2%
blocks.text: Poday apne upar parne wali sooraj ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 1-2% chemical tawanai mein badalte hain. Yeh kam lagta hai, lekin zameen ki taqreeban tamam zindagi ke liye kaafi hai.
Action spectrum

Photosynthetic pigments roshni ki mukhtalif wavelengths (rangon) ko mukhtalif had tak jazb karte hain, aur har wavelength photosynthesis mein barabar asar-daar bhi nahin hoti. Har wavelength kitni asar-daar hai, yeh action spectrum se maloom hota hai. Action spectrum ke liye poday par baari baari mukhtalif rangon ki roshni dali jati hai, aur har rang par patton se nikalne wali oxygen naap kar photosynthesis ki raftar maloom ki jati hai. Is data ka graph action spectrum kehlata hai. Pehla action spectrum German biologist T. W. Engelmann ne 1883 mein banaya. Unhon ne Spirogyra (ek alga) ke pigments par kaam kiya: Spirogyra ke filament par mukhtalif wavelengths ki roshni dalne se sab se zyada photosynthesis, aur sab se zyada oxygen, un cells mein hui jin par neeli (blue) aur surkh (red) roshni padi.
Carbon dioxide ka kirdar

Sugar, CO₂ ke reduction se banti hai jis mein ATP aur NADPH istemal hote hain; is tarah CO₂ sugar banane ke liye carbon ka zariya (source) hai. Carbon dioxide stomata (patte ke baareek suraakh) se patte mein dakhil hoti hai aur mesophyll cells ki cell walls mein maujood pani mein ghul jati hai. Patton mein stomata bari tadad mein hote hain, aur CO₂ ka andar aana stomata khulne par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Photosynthesis kahan hoti hai
blocks.text: Kul photosynthesis ka taqreeban 10% khushki ke poday karte hain; baqi samandaron, jheelon aur talabon mein hoti hai. Pani ke photosynthetic jandar ghuli hui CO₂, bicarbonates aur ghulne wale carbonates ko carbon ke zariye ke taur par istemal karte hain; khushki ke jandar hawa ki CO₂ istemal karte hain.
Pani ka kirdar

Photosynthesis mein CO₂ ko reduce karne ke liye hydrogen pani se aata hai. Photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen bhi pani se aati hai, is liye pani hawa ki oxygen ka aham zariya hai, jo zyada tar jandaron ko aerobic respiration aur zinda rehne ki tawanai ke liye chahiye.

blocks.title: Hypothesis ki bunyad
blocks.text: Van Niel ka mafrooza (hypothesis) un photosynthetic bacteria ki tehqeeq par mabni tha jo carbon dioxide se carbohydrate banate hain magar oxygen nahin chhorte.

1930 ki dahai mein Van Niel ne mafrooza diya ke poda hydrogen hasil karne ke liye pani ko torta hai aur oxygen zimni product (by-product) ke taur par nikalti hai. 1940 ki dahai mein scientists ne is ki tasdeeq ki. Is tajurbe mein oxygen ka isotopic tracer (¹⁸O, bhari oxygen) istemal hua. Laboratory mein bhari oxygen wala pani H₂¹⁸O aur bhari oxygen wali carbon dioxide C¹⁸O₂ tayyar ki gayi. Pehle group ke podon ko H₂¹⁸O aur aam CO₂ (C¹⁶O₂) di gayi. Doosre group ko C¹⁸O₂ aur aam pani (H₂¹⁶O) diya gaya. Dono ko photosynthesis ka mahol diya gaya aur nikalne wali oxygen jama kar ke jaanchi gayi. Pehle group ne ¹⁸O chhori aur doosre group ne aam oxygen (¹⁶O). Is se sabit hua ke nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Van Neil” aur “Neil’s hypothesis” chhapa hai; scientist ka sahi naam C. B. van Niel (Cornelis van Niel) hai.

blocks.alt: Do poday. Group 1 ke podon ko bhari oxygen wala pani, H2(18)O, aur aam CO2 diya jata hai, aur woh bhari oxygen (18)O2 chhorte hain. Group 2 ke podon ko aam pani aur C(18)O2 diya jata hai, aur woh aam O2 chhorte hain. Neeche do masawaat (equations): 6CO2 + 12H2(18)O se C6H12O6 + 6H2O + 6(18)O2; aur 6C(18)O2 + 12H2O se C6H12(18)O6 + 6H2(18)O + 6O2; bhari oxygen ke atoms rangeen hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3: Tajurba jo sabit karta hai ke photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen ka zariya pani hai (kitab ki Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rangeen O bhari oxygen (18-O) hai. Group 1 mein bhari oxygen sirf pani mein thi aur wohi hawa mein nikli. Group 2 mein bhari oxygen CO₂ mein thi, magar nikalne wali oxygen aam thi; CO₂ ki oxygen glucose aur naye pani mein gayi. Is liye nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai.

Photosynthesis mein pani toot kar hydrogen deta hai. Yeh hydrogen coenzyme nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADP) ko reduce kar ke NADPH banata hai. Yahi NADPH CO₂ ko sugar mein badalne ke liye “reducing power” (reduce karne ki taqat) ka kaam karta hai.
Photosynthetic pigments ka kirdar

Photosynthetic pigments thylakoid membranes mein hote hain aur photosynthesis ke liye zaroori roshni ki tawanai pakarte hain. Kuch pigments yeh hain: chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, xanthophylls aur carotenes. Mukhtalif pigments mukhtalif wavelengths (rangon) ki roshni jazb karte hain. Roshni zarraat (particles) ki dhaar ki tarah bhi baratti hai; in zarraat ko photons kehte hain. Pigment molecule ek waqt mein ek photon jazb karta hai.

blocks.title: Photon ki tawanai
blocks.text: Chhoti wavelength wale (neele) photons mein lambi wavelength wale (surkh) photons se zyada tawanai hoti hai. Zyada tawanai wale photons electrons ko zyada oonchi energy levels tak le jate hain.
Jab pigment molecule photon jazb karta hai to us ke electrons oonchi energy level par chale jate hain, aur molecule tawanai se bhar kar excited (josh mein) ho jata hai.
Chlorophylls

Chlorophyll ek lipid molecule hai. Chlorophylls kai qism ke hain: chlorophyll a, b, c aur d podon aur algae mein hote hain, jabke baqi photosynthetic bacteria mein hote hain aur bacteriochlorophylls kehlate hain.

Chlorophyll molecule ke do hisse hain: pani pasand (hydrophilic) sar aur pani se door rehne wali (hydrophobic) dum. Sar porphyrin ring ka bana hai jo chaar pyrrole rings (paanch kone wale, nitrogen wale compounds) se banta hai. In chaar rings ko beech mein ek magnesium atom jorta hai. Chlorophyll-a mein doosri pyrrole ring par methyl (CH₃) group hota hai, jabke chlorophyll-b mein usi jagah aldehyde (CHO) group hota hai. Porphyrin ring roshni jazb karti hai. Dum lambi hydrocarbon chain hai jo molecule ko thylakoid membrane mein jamaye (anchor) rakhti hai.

Chlorophylls zyada tar violet-blue aur orange-red roshni jazb karte hain. Sabz (green) roshni sab se kam jazb hoti hai; yeh guzar jati ya palat (reflect) jati hai, isi liye patte sabz nazar aate hain.

blocks.title: Carotenoids
blocks.text: Beta-carotene jaise carotenoids photosynthesis mein dohra kirdar ada karte hain: yeh spectrum ke neele aur sabz hisse ki roshni pakarte hain, aur zyada roshni se photosynthetic nizam ko nuqsan se bachate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar pyrrole chhallon ka porphyrin ring; har chhalle ka nitrogen atom beech ke magnesium atom se jura hai. Side groups: ring I par vinyl group (H2C=CH) aur CH3, ring II par R aur CH2-CH3, ring III par CH3, ring IV par H3C, aur ek paanchwan chhalla jis par C=O aur COOCH3 group hai. Ring IV se CH2-CH2 zanjeer ek ester group par khatam hoti hai jo lambi hydrocarbon zanjeer (chain) se juri hai. Key: R = CH3 chlorophyll a mein; R = CHO chlorophyll b mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Chlorophyll a aur chlorophyll b ki molecular banawat (kitab ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chaar pyrrole chhallon ka porphyrin ring; har chhalle ka nitrogen atom beech ke magnesium atom se jura hai. Side groups: ring I par vinyl group (H2C=CH) aur CH3, ring II par R aur CH2-CH3, ring III par CH3, ring IV par H3C, aur ek paanchwan chhalla jis par C=O aur COOCH3 group hai. Ring IV se CH2-CH2 zanjeer ek ester group par khatam hoti hai jo lambi hydrocarbon zanjeer (chain) se juri hai. Key: R = CH3 chlorophyll a mein; R = CHO chlorophyll b mein. Labels: Porphyrin ring (Hydrophilic head), Hydrocarbon chain (Hydrophobic tail).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sar (head) porphyrin ring hai jis ke beech Mg hai; yahi hissa roshni jazb (absorb) karta hai aur pani pasand (hydrophilic) hai. Lambi dum (tail) hydrocarbon hai jo pani se door bhagti (hydrophobic) hai aur thylakoid membrane mein dhansi rehti hai. Chlorophyll a aur b mein sirf ring II ka R group mukhtalif hai: a mein CH₃, b mein CHO.
Accessory pigments

Accessory (madadgar) pigments chlorophyll-a ke ilawa woh tamam pigments hain jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni jama kar sakte hain. Chlorophyll b ek accessory pigment hai; baqi carotenoids (carotenes aur xanthophylls) aur phycobilins hain. Chlorophyll b aur carotenoids podon mein milte hain, jabke phycobilins red algae aur cyanobacteria mein.
Jab accessory pigments roshni jazb karte hain to woh tawanai chlorophyll a ki taraf aage barha dete hain. Aam khayal hai ke podon mein tawanai is tarteeb se muntaqil hoti hai:
Absorption spectrum

Woh graph jo dikhaye ke koi pigment kaun kaun si wavelengths jazb karta hai, us pigment ka absorption spectrum kehlata hai. Chlorophylls ka absorption spectrum batata hai ke neeli roshni (430 nm) aur surkh roshni (670 nm) sab se zyada jazb hoti hai. Carotenoids ki jazb ki chotiyan (peaks) chlorophylls se mukhtalif hain (Fig 5.5-a). Photosynthesis ka action spectrum bhi dikhata hai ke neeli aur surkh roshni sab se zyada asar-daar hai. Yani photosynthesis ka action spectrum pigments ke absorption spectrum se mel khata hai.
Kuch wavelengths jo chlorophyll-a jazb nahin karta, chlorophyll-b unhein achi tarah jazb karta hai, aur ulta bhi. Is farq se dono chlorophylls mil kar roshni ki zyada wavelengths jazb kar lete hain.

blocks.alt: Rangeen spectrum ke upar do graph, wavelength 350 se 700 nm. (a) Absorption of light: chlorophyll-a (bhari lakeer) ki chotiyan taqreeban 430 aur 662 nm par, chlorophyll-b (tooti lakeer) 453 aur 642 nm par, carotenoids (nuqtedar) taqreeban 420 se 480 nm ke darmiyan; saath legend.

blocks.long_description: Rangeen spectrum ke upar do graph, wavelength 350 se 700 nm. (a) Absorption of light: chlorophyll-a (bhari lakeer) ki chotiyan taqreeban 430 aur 662 nm par, chlorophyll-b (tooti lakeer) 453 aur 642 nm par, carotenoids (nuqtedar) taqreeban 420 se 480 nm ke darmiyan; saath legend. (b) Photosynthesis rate / absorption rate: action spectrum (kaali lakeer) neeli aur surkh roshni mein ooncha aur sabz mein neecha hai; absorption spectrum (surmai hissa) us ke neeche hai aur us ki neeli aur surkh chotiyan milti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein dekhein har pigment kis rang ki roshni zyada jazb karta hai: chlorophylls neeli aur surkh, carotenoids neeli-sabz. Sabz roshni bohat kam jazb hoti hai, is liye patte sabz nazar aate hain. (b) mein photosynthesis ki raftar (action spectrum) wahin oonchi hai jahan pigments zyada roshni jazb karte hain; yeh sabit karta hai ke jazb hui roshni hi photosynthesis chalati hai.
Photosynthetic pigments ki tanzeem (photosystems)

Sooraj ki tawanai ko behtar tareeqe se jazb aur istemal karne ke liye photosynthetic pigments guchhon (clusters) mein munazzam hote hain jinhein photosystems kehte hain. Yeh photosystems chloroplast ki thylakoid membranes mein dhanse hote hain.

blocks.alt: Lambai ke rukh kata hua baizawi (oval) chloroplast jis ke stroma ke gird outer membrane aur inner membrane hain. Andar thali jaisi thylakoids ke chhe dher (grana) patli lamellae se jure hain. Labels: Outer membrane, Inner membrane, Stroma, Thylakoid, Granum (ek dher ke gird bracket), Lamella.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Chloroplast ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har chapti thali thylakoid hai; thylakoids ka dher granum (jama grana) kehlata hai. Grana ko jorne wali patli jhilliyan lamellae hain. Thylakoid membranes mein pigments aur photosystems hote hain (light-dependent reactions), aur in ke gird ka maadda stroma hai (Calvin cycle).

Photosystems mein photosynthetic pigments aur electron transport chain ke carriers hote hain. Har photosystem ke do hisse hain: roshni jama karne wala ‘antenna complex’ aur ‘reaction centre’ (Fig 5.7). Antenna complex ke bohat se pigment molecules roshni pakarte hain aur yeh tawanai reaction centre tak pohanchate hain (kitab ise high-energy electrons ki shakal kehti hai). Reaction centre mein chlorophyll-a ke ek ya zyada molecules hote hain jo high-energy electrons ko primary electron acceptor ko dete hain. Yeh acceptor unhein electron carriers ke silsile ko deta hai, jise electron transport chain kehte hain.

Chloroplast mein do photosystems hain: photosystem-I (PS-I) aur photosystem-II (PS-II); in ke naam daryaft ki tarteeb se rakhe gaye. PS-I ke reaction centre mein P700 chlorophyll-a hota hai jo 700 nm ki roshni sab se zyada jazb karta hai. PS-II ke reaction centre mein P680 chlorophyll-a hota hai jo 680 nm ki roshni sab se behtar jazb karta hai.

blocks.alt: Antenna ke sabz pigment molecules ka jhund jis ke beech gehra sabz reaction center hai. Photons antenna par girte hain; khamdar teer tawanai pigments se guzar kar reaction center tak le jate hain; ek bara teer 2e- ko reaction center se upar primary electron acceptor tak le jata hai. Labels: Photons, Pigment molecules of antenna, Reaction center, 2e-, Primary electron acceptor.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Photosystem (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Antenna ke pigments roshni pakarte hain magar electron khud nahin dete; woh tawanai ek se doosre molecule ko de kar reaction center (chlorophyll a ka khaas jora) tak pohanchate hain. Wahan do electrons itni tawanai pa lete hain ke chhalang laga kar primary electron acceptor par chale jate hain.
Photosynthesis ka tareeqa (mechanism)

Photosynthesis ek redox (oxidation-reduction) amal hai. Neeche ki equation dikhati hai ke jab pani ke molecules toot-te hain to woh oxidise hote hain (electrons aur hydrogen ions khote hain) aur oxygen banti hai. Saath hi CO₂ mein electrons aur hydrogen ions shamil hote hain aur woh reduce ho kar sugar banti hai. Is tarah oxidation aur reduction saath saath chalte hain.

Lekin yeh ek saada, ek qadam ka amal nahin; yeh reactions ke silsile wala pecheeda metabolic rasta hai. Light-dependent reactions grana ki thylakoid membranes par hote hain, jabke light-independent reactions chloroplast ke stroma mein hote hain. Figure 5.8 in reactions ka khulasa dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek chloroplast: baen taraf granum jis par Light Dependent Reactions (in grana) likha hai aur daen taraf stroma mein gol teer jis par Light Independent Reactions (in stroma) likha hai. Roshni aur H2O light-dependent reactions mein jate hain aur O2 nikalti hai; CO2 light-independent reactions mein jati hai aur Sugar nikalti hai. ATP aur NADPH grana se stroma ko jate hain; ADP + Pi aur NADP+ wapas aate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Photosynthesis ka khulasa (kitab ki Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do hisse ek doosre par munhasir hain. Grana roshni aur pani se ATP aur NADPH banate hain aur oxygen chhorte hain. Stroma in ATP aur NADPH se CO₂ ko sugar mein badalta hai, aur khaali hue ADP + Pi aur NADP⁺ dobara bharne ke liye grana ko lauta deta hai.
1- Light-dependent reactions
Light-dependent reactions ke aham waqiat yeh hain: (1) photosynthetic pigments ka roshni ki tawanai jazb karna, (2) is tawanai se electrons ka excite hona, aur (3) ATP aur NADPH ka banna.

ATP ka banna light-dependent reactions ka sab se aham qadam hai; ise photophosphorylation (roshni se ADP mein phosphate jorna) kehte hain. Yeh do tarah ka hai: non-cyclic photophosphorylation ya cyclic photophosphorylation.

blocks.title: Reducing aur assimilating powers
blocks.text: Light-dependent reactions mein roshni ki tawanai jazb ho kar chemical tawanai ban jati hai, jo reducing aur assimilating powers, yani NADPH aur ATP, ki shakal mein hoti hai. Light-independent reactions NADPH aur ATP se CO₂ ko reduce karte hain aur tawanai C-H bonds ki shakal mein jama karte hain.
a)- Non-cyclic photophosphorylation

Light-dependent reactions mein ATP banne ka yeh aam tareeqa hai. Is non-cyclic raste mein dono photosystems, PS-I aur PS-II, hissa lete hain aur do electron chains kaam karti hain (Fig. 5.9). Yeh is tarah hota hai:

items: PS-II ka roshni jazb karna: jab PS-II par roshni parti hai to us ke antenna ke chlorophyll molecules ki energy level barh jati hai. Do excited electrons un se nikal kar doosre chlorophyll molecules se hote hue reaction centre ke P680 chlorophyll tak pohanchte hain. Is tawanai se P680 ke do excited electrons PS-II ke primary electron acceptor ko chale jate hain. Is se P680 mein electron ka “hole” (khali jagah) ban jata hai, aur P680 ek taqatwar oxidizing agent (electrons kheenchne wala) ban jata hai.

Pani ki photolysis: chlorophyll ka electron “hole” pani ke electrons se bharta hai. Jab pani ka molecule PS-II ke oxidise-shuda chlorophyll se react karta hai to woh do hydrogen ions, ek oxygen atom (jo foran doosre oxygen atom se mil kar O₂ banata hai) aur do electrons mein toot jata hai. Yeh do electrons P680 ka “hole” bharte hain. Roshni se pani torne ke is qadam ko photolysis kehte hain.

PS-II se PS-I tak electrons ka bahao: qadam 1 mein P680 ke excited electrons PS-II ke primary electron acceptor ne liye the. Ab yeh electrons PS-II ki electron transport chain se guzar kar PS-I tak jate hain. Is chain ke carriers plastoquinone (PQ), cytochrome complex aur plastocyanin (PC) hain. Chain mein neeche jate hue electrons ki tawanai kam hoti jati hai, aur thylakoid membrane yeh tawanai chemiosmosis ke zariye ATP banane mein istemal karti hai.

PS-I ka roshni jazb karna: agle qadam mein PS-I roshni jazb karta hai aur us ke chlorophyll molecules ki energy level bohat ooncha ho jata hai. Reaction centre ke P700 chlorophyll ke excited electrons PS-I ke primary electron acceptor ko jate hain. PS-II se aane wale electrons P700 ka electron “hole” bharte hain.

PS-I se NADP⁺ tak electrons ka bahao: PS-I ka primary electron acceptor excited electrons ko doosri electron transport chain ko deta hai, jahan ferredoxin (FD) unhein leta hai. Enzyme NADP reductase yeh electrons FD se NADP⁺ ko deta hai. Jab NADP⁺ ko do electrons aur ek H⁺ ion milta hai to woh reduce ho kar NADPH ban jata hai. Is tarah high-energy electrons NADPH mein jama ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Hawa ki oxygen
blocks.text: Photolysis mein banne wali oxygen hi hawa ki oxygen ka bunyadi zariya hai.

blocks.alt: PHOTOSYSTEM II ke antenna par photons girte hain; tawanai P680 tak pohanchti hai aur 2e- us ke primary electron acceptor tak upar jate hain. Pani toot-ta hai: H2O se 2H+, aadhi O2 aur 2e-, aur yeh 2e- P680 ki kami poori karte hain. Acceptor se 2e- PQ, cytochrome complex aur PC se guzar kar PHOTOSYSTEM I ke P700 tak neeche aate hain; is zanjeer ke saath narangi tikon par Energy for synthesis of ATP by chemiosmosis likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.9: Light-dependent reactions (noncyclic photophosphorylation) (kitab ki Figure 5.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: PHOTOSYSTEM II ke antenna par photons girte hain; tawanai P680 tak pohanchti hai aur 2e- us ke primary electron acceptor tak upar jate hain. Pani toot-ta hai: H2O se 2H+, aadhi O2 aur 2e-, aur yeh 2e- P680 ki kami poori karte hain. Acceptor se 2e- PQ, cytochrome complex aur PC se guzar kar PHOTOSYSTEM I ke P700 tak neeche aate hain; is zanjeer ke saath narangi tikon par Energy for synthesis of ATP by chemiosmosis likha hai. PHOTOSYSTEM I par photons P700 se 2e- ko doosre primary electron acceptor tak, phir FD tak bhejte hain; 2e- aur H+ NADP+ ko NADPH banate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Electrons ka raasta Z jaisa hai: roshni do dafa unhein upar dhakelti hai (PS-II aur PS-I par). Beech mein PQ, cytochrome complex aur PC se neeche aate hue jo tawanai nikalti hai woh chemiosmosis se ATP banati hai. Aakhir mein electrons NADPH mein pohanchte hain, aur PS-II ki kami pani ke tootne (photolysis) se poori hoti hai.

Is tarah roshni ki tawanai chemical tawanai (ATP aur NADPH) mein badal jati hai. Electrons PS-II, PS-I aur electron transport chains se jo zigzag (tedha meda) rasta tay karte hain use Z-scheme kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “PS-II and PS-II” chhapa hai; sahi yeh hai ke electrons PS-II aur PS-I dono se guzarte hain.
b)- Cyclic photophosphorylation

Kuch halaat mein PS-I ke excited electrons ek doosra rasta lete hain jise cyclic electron flow kehte hain. Is raste mein sirf PS-I kaam karta hai, PS-II nahin. Electrons PS-I ke primary electron acceptor se electron transport chain ke zariye wapas P700 chlorophyll tak ghoom kar aate hain. Is mein NADPH nahin banta aur oxygen nahin nikalti, lekin ATP banta hai (Fig 5.10). Aisa tab hota hai jab Calvin cycle sust ho jaye aur chloroplast mein NADPH jama ho jaye.

blocks.alt: Sirf PHOTOSYSTEM I: us ke antenna par photons girte hain, tawanai P700 tak pohanchti hai aur 2e- primary electron acceptor tak upar jate hain. Nuqtedar teer 2e- ko wapas cytochrome complex tak le jata hai, jise PQ se bhi 2e- milte hain; cytochrome complex se 2e- PC aur phir wapas P700 tak jate hain. Zanjeer ke saath narangi tikon par Energy for synthesis of ATP by chemiosmosis likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.10: Cyclic photophosphorylation (kitab ki Figure 5.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan electrons chakkar laga kar usi P700 par wapas aa jate hain, is liye na pani toot-ta hai, na oxygen nikalti hai, na NADPH banta hai. Sirf zanjeer se guzarte hue nikli tawanai se ATP banta hai. Jab Calvin cycle ko NADPH se zyada ATP chahiye ho to yeh raasta kaam aata hai.
Chemiosmosis

Light-dependent reactions mein jab electrons electron transport chain ke carriers se guzarte hain to oxidation aur reduction reactions hote hain: jo carrier electrons deta hai woh oxidise hota hai aur jo agla carrier electrons leta hai woh reduce hota hai. Ek carrier se doosre tak jate hue electrons tawanai khote hain. Chemiosmosis woh tareeqa hai jis mein thylakoid membranes in redox reactions ko ATP banne ke saath jor deti hain.

Chemiosmosis electrons se nikli tawanai se ATP kaise banati hai? Yeh tawanai H⁺ ions ko chloroplast ke stroma se thylakoid ke andar wale hisse (lumen) mein active transport (tawanai laga kar dhakelna) ke zariye bhejne mein kharch hoti hai. Is tarah lumen mein bohat se H⁺ ions jama ho jate hain. Lumen mein H⁺ ka yeh gradient (zyada aur kam ka farq) potential energy (chhupi tawanai) rakhta hai. H⁺ ions lumen se wapas stroma mein (zyada concentration se kam concentration ki taraf) diffuse karte hain. Wapas aate hue yeh thylakoid membrane ke ek khaas protein se guzarte hain; yeh protein ek enzyme hai jise ATP synthase kehte hain. Yeh enzyme H⁺ ke bahao ki tawanai se ADP aur inorganic phosphate (Pi) ko jor deta hai. Is tarah ADP, ATP ban jata hai aur tawanai us mein band ho jati hai (Fig 5.11).

blocks.title: Ek hi tareeqa
blocks.text: Mitochondria aur chloroplasts dono ki electron transport chains chemiosmosis ke ek hi tareeqe se ATP banati hain.

blocks.alt: Ek chhota chloroplast (Thylakoid, Stroma) thylakoid membrane ke ek hisse ki taraf ishara karta hai jo thylakoid lumen (upar) aur stroma (neeche) ke darmiyan hai. Membrane mein: PS II, electron carriers, PS I aur ATP synthase. Roshni PS II aur PS I par girti hai. Lumen mein H2O 2H+ aur aadhi O2 mein toot kar 2e- deta hai. Peela raasta electrons ko carriers aur PS I se stroma tak le jata hai jahan NADP+ + H+ NADPH bante hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.11: Chloroplast mein electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis (kitab ki Figure 5.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ek chhota chloroplast (Thylakoid, Stroma) thylakoid membrane ke ek hisse ki taraf ishara karta hai jo thylakoid lumen (upar) aur stroma (neeche) ke darmiyan hai. Membrane mein: PS II, electron carriers, PS I aur ATP synthase. Roshni PS II aur PS I par girti hai. Lumen mein H2O 2H+ aur aadhi O2 mein toot kar 2e- deta hai. Peela raasta electrons ko carriers aur PS I se stroma tak le jata hai jahan NADP+ + H+ NADPH bante hain. Surmai teer H+ ko stroma se lumen mein pump karta hai; H+ lumen mein jama ho kar ATP synthase se wapas behte hain aur stroma mein ADP + P se ATP banta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Electrons ki tawanai H⁺ ko stroma se lumen mein dhakelti hai, aur pani ke tootne se bhi lumen mein H⁺ barhte hain. Lumen mein H⁺ ka hujoom (gradient) ban jata hai. H⁺ sirf ATP synthase ke raste wapas stroma mein aa sakte hain, aur yahi bahao ADP + P ko ATP mein jorta hai. Isi ko chemiosmosis kehte hain.
2- Light-independent reactions

Light-independent reactions chloroplast ke stroma mein hone wale reactions ka silsila hain. Yeh CO₂ se carbon, ATP se tawanai aur NADPH se hydrogen le kar tawanai se bhari sugar banate hain. Inhein dark reactions bhi kehte hain. Jab tak ATP aur NADPH maujood hon, yeh reactions roshni mein bhi ho sakte hain aur andhere mein bhi (Fig 5.11). Calvin cycle ko neeche diye gaye marahil (phases) mein baanta jata hai.

Dark reactions ki tafseel Melvin Calvin aur un ke saathiyon ne University of California mein daryaft ki, isi liye dark reactions ko Calvin cycle bhi kehte hain. Is kaam par Calvin ko 1961 mein Nobel Prize mila.
Phase I: carbon fixation

Carbon fixation ka matlab hai CO₂ ka pehli baar organic madde mein shamil hona. Ek enzyme, ribulose biphosphate carboxylase (Rubisco; shayad zameen par sab se zyada paya jane wala protein), CO₂ ke teen molecules ko ek paanch-carbon sugar, ribulose biphosphate (RuBP), ke teen molecules se jorta hai. Is se ek teen-carbon compound, 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ya 3-phosphoglycerate, ke chhe molecules bante hain.

blocks.title: C-3 pathway
blocks.text: Chunke carbon fixation ka pehla product teen carbon wala compound hai, is liye Calvin cycle ko C-3 pathway bhi kehte hain.

blocks.alt: CALVIN CYCLE ke gird carbon-moti dabbon ka chakkar. Marhala I, Carbon Fixation: 3 CO2 Rubisco ki madad se 3 ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) se jur kar 6 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) banate hain. Marhala II, Reduction: 6 ATP se 6 ADP bante hain aur 3-PGA 6 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid ban jata hai; 6 NADPH se 6 NADP+ bante hain, 6 P alag hote hain aur 6 glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) bante hain. Ek G3P glucose aur doosre compounds ke liye nikal jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.12: Calvin cycle (kitab ki Figure 5.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: CALVIN CYCLE ke gird carbon-moti dabbon ka chakkar. Marhala I, Carbon Fixation: 3 CO2 Rubisco ki madad se 3 ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) se jur kar 6 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) banate hain. Marhala II, Reduction: 6 ATP se 6 ADP bante hain aur 3-PGA 6 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid ban jata hai; 6 NADPH se 6 NADP+ bante hain, 6 P alag hote hain aur 6 glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) bante hain. Ek G3P glucose aur doosre compounds ke liye nikal jata hai. Marhala III, Regeneration of RuBP: 5 G3P 2 P khote hain aur 3 ATP (3 ADP bante hain) istemal kar ke 3 RuBP dobara banate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har dabbe mein neele moti carbon atoms aur peele P phosphate hain; baen number molecules ki tadad hai. 3 CO₂ ke liye cycle 9 ATP aur 6 NADPH kharch karta hai aur 1 G3P bachata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki chhapi hui figure mein 6 ATP aur 6 NADPH par teer ki nok in ki taraf hai, jaise yeh ban rahe hon; durust yeh hai ke ATP aur NADPH kharch hote hain (ATP se ADP, NADPH se NADP⁺), jaisa yahan dikhaya gaya hai. Kitab mein '1,3-Biphsophoglyceric acid' chhapa hai; durust hijje 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid hain.
Phase II: reduction

Is phase mein chhe ATP se chhe phosphate groups le kar 3-PGA ke molecules mein jore jate hain, aur har 3-PGA, 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid ban jata hai. Phir har 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid reduce ho kar glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) banta hai; is reduction ke liye hydrogen NADPH deta hai. Is qadam mein 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid se phosphate groups alag bhi hote hain.

blocks.title: Phir G3P
blocks.text: G3P wohi teen-carbon sugar hai jo glycolysis (cellular respiration ka pehla marhala) mein glucose ke tootne se banti hai.
Is tarah G3P ke chhe molecules bante hain jin mein se ek molecule cycle se bahar nikal jata hai. Yeh doosre G3P se mil kar glucose banata hai, jo aage doosre carbohydrates mein badal sakta hai.
Phase III: RuBP ka dobara banna

Reactions ke ek silsile se G3P ke paanch molecules ribulose phosphate (RuP) ke teen molecules mein badalte hain. Light reactions ke teen ATP istemal kar ke har RuP mein ek phosphate group jora jata hai aur RuBP ke teen molecules ban jate hain. Yeh RuBP phir CO₂ lete hain aur cycle chalta rehta hai.

blocks.caption: Teen CO₂ ke liye Calvin cycle ke inputs aur outputs
rows: 6 G3P (1 nikalta hai; 2 ek glucose banate hain)

blocks.prompt: Ek poda tez roshni mein rakha hai magar us ke stomata zabardasti band hain. Batayen ke reactions ka kaun sa set pehle rukta hai, kaun si paidawar jama hoti hai, aur chloroplast kis mutabadil electron raste par ja sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: CO₂ na hone par stroma ka Calvin cycle pehle rukta hai, to ATP aur NADPH kharch nahin hote aur NADPH jama hota hai. Light reactions thori der chalte hain, aur chloroplast cyclic photophosphorylation par chala jata hai, jis mein PS-I ke electrons wapas P700 tak ghoomte hain aur ATP banta hai magar NADPH aur oxygen nahin.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: 6CO₂ + 12H₂O + roshni se C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ + 6H₂O; ek redox amal jis mein pani oxidise aur CO₂ reduce hoti hai. Roshni tawanai deti hai, CO₂ carbon, aur pani hydrogen aur nikalne wali oxygen (bhari-oxygen tajurba; Van Niel).

Thylakoids ke pigments photons jazb karte hain: chlorophyll a (Mg wala porphyrin sar, hydrocarbon dum; ring II par CH₃), chlorophyll b (CHO), accessory pigments ke taur par carotenoids aur phycobilins. Jazb ki chotiyan 430 aur 670 nm par; action spectrum is se milta hai (Engelmann, 1883).
Photosystems: antenna complex, reaction centre (PS-I mein P700, PS-II mein P680), primary acceptor, electron transport chain.

Non-cyclic photophosphorylation (Z-scheme): PS-II excited, pani ki photolysis P680 bharti aur O₂ chhorti hai, electrons PQ, cytochrome complex, PC se utar kar chemiosmosis se ATP banate hain, PS-I excited, ferredoxin aur NADP reductase NADPH banate hain. Cyclic: sirf PS-I, sirf ATP.
Stroma mein Calvin cycle: rubisco se carbon fixation (3 CO₂ + 3 RuBP se 6 3-PGA), 6 ATP aur 6 NADPH se 6 G3P mein reduction (ek glucose ke liye nikalta hai), 3 ATP se 3 RuBP ka dobara banna.
